evidence: TOS role matrix; cloud IAM export

implementation_statement: Gap: no information flow enforcement between the gate and yard network and OT. Planned: an internal firewall with an OT zone that allows only the TOS equipment interface, VMT and PACS flows (P04).
Standard users have no local administrator rights on office endpoints. Gaps: 7 TOS administrators where 5 are needed; a shared local administrator on gate servers; one shared OT engineering account.
evidence: TOS role export; gate server local groups

implementation_statement: The identity provider locks accounts for 15 minutes after 10 failed attempts. Gap: gate servers and the VPN appliance have no lockout.
evidence: IdP policy; gate server local policy

implementation_statement: Office endpoints lock after 10 minutes. Gap: gate booth workstations and HMIs do not lock.

Staff remote access uses a VPN appliance with password-only authentication. Gap: the crane vendor has an always-on remote access appliance with a cellular modem and a shared account, outside the VPN (P01 R-003).
VMT Wi-Fi uses WPA2 with a pre-shared key and is bridged into the gate and yard network. Planned: WPA2-Enterprise with device certificates in the OT zone.
Awareness and training policy is in POL-05 (P06). Training procedure, including the Subpart F topics and timing, is due 2026-10-31.

Recovery procedures will be written into the contingency plan due 2026-12-31, using the P05 recovery order.
Office, TOS and cloud users authenticate with unique IDs through the identity provider. Gap: shared gate clerk accounts; shared vendor account on the crane remote access appliance.
MFA is enforced for the TOS administrator group, which includes the cloud console administrators. Gap: gate server local administrators and the OT engineering account have no MFA.
MFA is enforced for email. Gap: TOS standard users and the staff VPN use passwords only. Planned for 2026-11-30.
The identity provider enforces a 12-character minimum and a banned-password list. Gaps: default passwords on OT devices; 4-digit PINs on HMIs; no strength rule on gate servers.

implementation_statement: Gap: OCR servers run an operating system that reaches end of vendor support in 2026-12. Replacement ordered for 2026-11.

An internet firewall managed by the MSP blocks unsolicited inbound traffic; site-to-site VPN to the cloud tenant. Gaps: office-to-yard routing is unfiltered and OT shares the gate network; crane vendor appliance bypasses the firewall.

TLS 1.2 or higher for TOS web and APIs; AS2 or SFTP with 5 of 6 carriers, the port community system and the customs data exchange service. Gaps: 1 carrier on plain FTP; OT protocols unencrypted with no feasibility review.
Providers use validated cryptographic modules per their SOC 2 system descriptions.
The TOS database and cloud disks are encrypted at rest by the provider. Gap: gate server disks are not encrypted.
Office endpoints are patched monthly by the MSP. Gaps: gate servers, firewall firmware and OT patched ad hoc; KEVs not tracked.
MSP-managed antivirus on Windows endpoints and servers. Gaps: no EDR; alerts go to an unmonitored mailbox after hours.
Gap: no security monitoring. Planned: MSP-managed EDR with 24x7 alerting by 2026-12-31 and IT-OT boundary monitoring by 2027-03-31.
